Package dev.px.core.hud

Class Size

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.hud.Size
public final class Size extends Object
An immutable width and height, with no position.

What an element reports from HudElement.getPreferredSize(). It is expected to change every frame — a clock is wider at 12:00 than at 1:00, an ArrayList grows as modules are enabled — so nothing caches it.
